title: Hey @nbcconnecticut we need to get the word out. Someone or @eversource needs to make potable water available fast. Facing heat wave on top of no rain
summary: Hey @nbcconnecticut we need to get the word out. Someone or @eversource needs to make potable water available fast. Facing heat wave on top of no rain. Town wells running dry. Power be awesome..but a truck of water. Solvable.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Hey @nbcconnecticut we need to get the word out. Someone or @eversource needs to make potable water available fast.

Facing heat wave on top of no rain. Town wells running dry.

Power be awesome..but a truck of water. Solvable.
